title: Ring Oscillator VCO
text: Model ring oscillator VCO, 1 input, 1 output; {Specify using} defines how VCO output frequency is specified Voltage, {Voltage sensitivity (Hz/V)} sets the measure of change in output frequency of VCO, {Free running frequency (Hz)} sets the vCO output frequency without control voltage, {Control voltage (V)} controls voltage values, {Output frequency (Hz)} sets the vCO output frequency values, {Output amplitude (V)} sets the maximum amplitude of VCO output voltage, {Enable increased buffer size}, {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of input buffering available during, {Add phase noise}, {Model double sided phase noise instead of single sided} sets the model double-sided phase noise instead, {Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)} sets the frequency offsets of specified phase noise from carrier frequency, {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the specified phase noise power at phase noise frequency offsets relative to the carrier, {Estimate phase noise parameters} sets the noise parameters intended to match specified noise spectrum, {Period jitter (S)} sets the standard deviation of period jitter, {Flicker corner frequency (Hz)} sets the corner frequency of flicker, {Customize flicker exponent (Advanced feature)} sets the customize flicker noise power spectral, {Flicker exponent} sets the flicker noise power exponent and {Plot fit} plots specified and expected output phase noise density. Values come from the instance.
